messages:
IncidentsBot: :rotating_light: Pager: model-serving-eu — sampling distribution deviation detected for model 'redwood-v2-sampling' (error rate within generation heuristics > 8% threshold). Triggering on-call. Thread: 2313159876
Neha (oncall): seen. I'm paged and looking now. Any deploys in last 30m?
Devon (ML Eng): yes, we pushed a quantized sampling change to canary at 2313156000, rolled to eu region only. It was a config tweak to the top-k/top-p defaults to reduce hallucinations.
Neha (oncall): ok pulling logs. Can you post the canary snapshot id and the exact config?
Devon (ML Eng): snapshot: q-sample-2026-03-15-17:02, config: {"top_k":40, "top_p":0.92, "temperature":0.9, "sampling_rng_seed":auto} — we changed top_k from 50->40 and introduced a RNG refactor.
Maria (SRE): getting increased tail latency for generation jobs hitting eu-west1 G4s, but CPU on host looks ok. KV cache hit rates are normal.
Neha (oncall): logs show a cluster of high-entropy responses for a subset of prompts — clients reporting repeated terse outputs then sudden long repeats. Could be sampling RNG bug.
Devon (ML Eng): that sounds like RNG reseed bug I tried to fix. Reverting to previous snapshot might be safest. Can we pin traffic to previous model?
Eve (infra): we can route eu region traffic to blue pool (redwood-v2-stable) in < 3 min. Lia, any customer reports?
Lia (Support): received 2 support tickets in last 10m from Partner A complaining about inconsistent completions. No P0 customer impacted yet but Partner B raised concerns via CS.
Neha (oncall): decision time: rollback canary ASAP then assess. Devon, prepare rollback command. OpsBot: please start incident doc in #incidents-log (auto-create).
OpsBot: Incident doc created: https://internal/docs/incidents/2313159876 (stub)
Devon (ML Eng): rollback CLI: 
```
redwoodctl deploy rollback --region eu-west1 --model redwood-v2-sampling --to-snapshot stable-2026-03-10
```
Devon (ML Eng): executing now.
IncidentsBot: Deploy rollback started by Devon at 2313157400.
Maria (SRE): routing change in progress. I'll monitor latencies.
Neha (oncall): Neha -> Sam for customer comm. We need a quick status page update and an optional customer-facing note. Draft below.
Sam (Product): ack. Draft status page update (short): "We are investigating degraded generation quality in eu-west1 affecting redwood-v2-sampling. A rollback to the previous model variant is in progress; we expect normal behavior to resume shortly. We will post updates as we have them." Thoughts?
Lia (Support): add note: "If you see truncated or repetitive outputs, restart requests or pin to redwood-v2-stable in the interim." Provide pin instructions?
Devon (ML Eng): pinning instruction: set model param model_version=stable-2026-03-10 in the request or use route header X-Model-Version: stable-2026-03-10. Example: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "X-Model-Version: stable-2026-03-10" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"..."}'
```
Neha (oncall): good. Lia, please send a short proactive message to the affected customers we know (Partner A, Partner B). Use the support template below.
Lia (Support): Draft customer DM to Partner A:
"Hi Team, we observed degraded generation behavior for the redwood-v2-sampling model in eu-west1 starting ~17:02 UTC. We've rolled back the canary and are validating outputs now. If you'd like immediate mitigation, you can pin to stable-2026-03-10 (instructions included). We'll follow up when validation is complete. — Lia, Support"
Sam (Product): add ETA line: "Expected remediation within 20 minutes; followup when validated."
Neha (oncall): rollback finished at 2313157800 per OpsBot. Maria, do we see metrics normalizing?
Maria (SRE): sampling variance metric trending down. Latency restored to baseline. KV cache normal. No new errors in gen pipeline.
Devon (ML Eng): running eval set now against stable snapshot; early pass looks good, sampling distribution matches pre-change profiles.
Neha (oncall): will keep this as active incident until validation completes. OpsBot, update incident severity to SEV2 and add oncall-handoff note.
OpsBot: Incident 2313159876 severity updated to SEV2. On-call handoff required in 45m.
Neha (oncall): Neha -> Maria: please be primary SRE for the handoff in 45m.
Maria (SRE): will do.
Devon (ML Eng): follow-up action items: 1) revert RNG refactor test branch and write unit tests for RNG state across batches, 2) re-run canary in staging with extended sampling tests, 3) add monitoring for sudden distribution shifts.
Sam (Product): internal comms template for impacted internal stakeholders: 
"Heads up: Degraded sampling behavior observed in eu-west1 for redwood-v2-sampling after a canary deploy. We rolled back to stable-2026-03-10 and are validating outputs. Customer outreach initiated for known partners. Action items assigned to ML Eng and SRE. No additional customer escalations at this time"
Lia (Support): sent DMs to Partner A & B and filed a follow-up ticket with logs.
Neha (oncall): status page updated at 2313158100. Message posted to partners via support at 2313158200.
IncidentsBot: Auto-notification: Follow-up health checks scheduled every 2 minutes for 30 minutes.
Eve (infra): running extended smoke tests on eu-west1. All smoke completions look good so far.
Devon (ML Eng): will open a postmortem ticket and include regression test vectors. Anyone want to add anything to the immediate comms?
Sam (Product): add a blameless note: "root cause under investigation; likely RNG reseed bug tied to refactor."
Maria (SRE): note for runbook update: add step to pin traffic and rollback canary within 5 minutes for sampling distribution alerts.
Neha (oncall): thanks all — keeping this thread live for the next handoff. I'll post a final resolution once validation window closes. :white_check_mark:
